data.one_liner: An enhanced NestedScrollView providing overscroll support for parent and nested scroll views.
data.what_it_does: NestedScrollViewPlus is an enhanced version of Flutter's NestedScrollView. It adds overscroll support for both the nested and parent scroll views, creating a more seamless scrolling experience.
use_when: You need overscroll support for both parent and nested scroll views.
You want a drop-in replacement for NestedScrollView to fix scrolling conflicts.
avoid_when: You are using a standard SingleChildScrollView or ListView without nesting.
You do not require custom overscroll mechanics.
strengths: Supports overscroll on both nested and parent scroll views.
Easy replacement for standard NestedScrollView widgets.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of inner CustomScrollView physics.
May require tracking older Flutter versions via a separate repository if not using recent Flutter.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and replace NestedScrollView with NestedScrollViewPlus.
